warnings.message: allow write ** dropped on claude: the read-only tier never writes

Claude Code's sandbox on Linux ignores glob patterns in Edit rules too: forbid write **/.git/hooks/** binds the Edit and Write tools, not a sandboxed command there; list the paths it means to protect by name

Claude Code's sandbox on Linux ignores glob patterns, and no literal path covers **/.env; **/secrets/**: sandboxed commands there can read a file these name. The Read tool's deny holds; the forbid guard denies a shell command that names such a path, and listing the files by path in deny_read makes the sandbox hold them
WebFetch outside allow_domains prompts a human instead of being denied; the sandbox allowlist binds shell commands only
